settings.scope: Development observation-budget experiment on the same regenerated 24 scalar states, with new shared noise streams. Nested budget-blind trajectories, not independent budget trials or a new-state publication test. All policies use the same cumulative conditional verifier; shared Gaussian weighting is approximate, especially under temporal correlation. No real data, novel method, calibrated posterior or general safety claim.
